title: Wave propagation direction
description: Essential: The response must correctly state the wave is propagating in the positive x-direction.

title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the wave speed as 1 m/s from the wavelength and period.

title: Q's vibration equation
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct vibration equation for particle Q: y = 2 cos(πt/4 + π/3) cm.

title: Q's x-coordinate
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the x-coordinate of particle Q at t=0 as 8 2/3 m.

title: Wavelength and period extraction
description: Important: The solution must correctly extract the wavelength (8 m) from the waveform graph and the period (8 s) from the vibration graph.

title: Initial phase determination
description: Important: The solution must correctly determine the initial phase (π/3 rad) for particle Q using its displacement at t=0.

title: Sign error in phase
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses a negative sign for the initial phase (e.g., -π/3) incorrectly.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s, cm for displacement) throughout.

title: Time to equilibrium logic
description: Important: The solution correctly calculates the time for Q to reach equilibrium (2/3 s) from its initial phase and angular frequency.
